answer.summary: XtmHubNewsFeedSyncIntegrationTest.given_groupMembers_should_createItems failed with expected 1 item but got 0. The log shows the XTM Hub rejecting the registration token for every tenant and a 'database down' IllegalStateException in NewsFeedItemService.createMissingItems, so the empty result looks environmental. The touched file (CommandArgumentBinderTest) is unrelated, and this test has no flake history. Other errors in the run (ES mapping, engine down) also look environmental. Confidence is moderate because the log does not directly prove the test's data path was the cause.

evidence.quote: XTM Hub rejected the registration token of every registered tenant
The XTM Hub news feed items could not be created: unexpected
